services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Fishing getting into full swing now. Had a good bluefin tuna season in January. Will post pictures soon on the tunas. February and March, we've been catching a lot of black bass from 5 miles out to 30 miles. Been to the gulf stream the past two weeks and have been catching nice wahoo and yellowfin tuna. It's time to book for the next two months for gulfstream fishing because the fishing out there will be phenomenal. 1/2 day and 3/4 day trips are showing black bass and little tuny have started biting good on these inshore trips. Will be posting pictures of gulfstream trips soon also. 13 year old Marcienne Anderson pulled in this 5ft, 45 LB Wahoo while trolling in the Gulf Stream off of

includes: Spacious live wells for keeping bait fresh
blurb: Fish Hook Charters provides fishing trips ranging from half-day excursions to 14-hour Gulf Stream adventures. They offer deep sea fishing for big game, shark fishing, bottom fishing, and inshore fishing experiences. Their boats are equipped with tournament-grade tackle, modern electronics, onboard bathrooms, Pompanette fighting chairs, and spacious live wells.
